name: Keytruda (Pembrolizumab)
clinical_indication: Advanced metastatic melanoma, non-small cell lung cancer (NSCLC), head and neck squamous cell carcinoma, and classical Hodgkin lymphoma refractory to standard chemotherapy regimens.
mechanism: Humanized IgG4 monoclonal antibody that binds to the PD-1 receptor, blocking interaction with PD-L1 and PD-L2, thereby reactivating tumor-infiltrating cytotoxic T-lymphocytes to mount an effective anti-tumor immune response.
